description: Render OODS Foundry objects or compositions at four fidelity levels. boxes-arrows draws declared object relationships as dagre SVG (object/depth or objects set); schema/schemaRef draws explicitly labelled component containment. wireframe draws the composed tree, regions, component names and field bindings with responsive layout and selected brand/theme tokens; review adds recorded node confidence, never invented scores. branded-mockup uses static sample HTML in the chosen built brand and light/dark/hc theme. Object+context composes a screen; schemaRef or inline schema uses an existing UiSchema. Legacy Object Catalog manifest input and nine packaged registry fixtures remain supported. Legacy branded mockups use light tokens; Unknown brands return OODS-BM-002 on that legacy path. Drawings are not live applications or referential-integrity checks.

inputSchema.description: Render OODS Foundry object relationships or composed component trees. Exactly one object, objects set, schemaRef, UiSchema, fixture or legacy manifest. Wireframes follow regions/components/field bindings; composition diagrams show containment. Named fixtures are packaged registry data.

context.description: Context to compose for a single object in wireframe, review or branded-mockup.

fidelityKind.description: Which HTML fidelity emitter to invoke.

fixture.description: Named allow-listed Object Catalog fixture shipped in registry data; unknown names return OODS-FP-001.

manifest.description: Inline Object Catalog manifest to render — an alternative to `fixture`. Data only; no file path is accepted, so this does not reopen the traversal surface the fixture allow-list closes. Must contain an `entities` array. Mutually exclusive with `fixture`. Malformed input returns OODS-FP-005.

object.description: Registered object. boxes-arrows draws its declared relationships; other views compose it in context.

objects.description: Explicit object set; draw only declared edges within this set. boxes-arrows only.

brandOverlay.description: Built brand for object relationship diagrams, composed wireframes, reviews, component containment and branded mockups in the chosen theme; legacy branded-mockup uses light.

depth.description: Outgoing relationship depth for a single object. An explicit objects set is never expanded.

includeStyles.description: Omit HTML style blocks when false. Diagram SVG retains its explicit paint attributes.

reviewThreshold.description: Recorded confidence below this threshold is flagged in review. Missing composition scores say Not recorded; no confidence is inferred.

theme.description: Built token scope for object relationship diagrams and composed branded mockups.

variant.description: Projection-variant selector passed through to the emitter / runPreEmit()).

schemaRef.description: Cached UiSchema from design.compose or schema load; missing/expired refs return a typed error.

name: fidelity_preview
